title: The Price of Compliance: emission-mask-constrained adversarial attacks on deep learning spectrum sensing in the 5.9 GHz ITS band (research framework)
description: Complete Phase-1 research framework: post-FCC 5.9 GHz coexistence waveform generators (C-V2X PC5, 802.11p, U-NII-4 Wi-Fi), TR 37.885-inspired channels, a differentiable receiver front-end, the mask-constrained waveform-domain adversarial attack (the Compliant Attacker), mask-matched adversarial training defense, MEAP / Price-of-Compliance metrics, and the paper draft with its claim-verification matrix. All result JSONs embed configuration and seeds.
